Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class ExportTeamParams

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExportTeamParams
public final class ExportTeamParams extends Object
Typed parameters for exporting an agent team definition to a destination.

overwrite is the export parameter currently supported by DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT.EXPORT_TEAM. A null value omits the optional database parameter object.

Since:
1.1.0
